title: Should There be a Teacher In-the-Loop? A Study of Generative AI-Personalized Tasks Middle School
abstract: arXiv:2602.15876v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models can be used to design instructional tasks to align to students needs. These generative AI models can create tasks that correspond to students out-of-school interests in areas like sports or music, which may enhance students interest in learning. However, little is known about teachers processes for creating or modifying tasks with generative AI, despite commercial AI companies claims that they will save teachers time. In the present study, 7 middle school mathematics teachers used ChatGPT to create personalized versions of problems in their curriculum to correspond to their students interests. The prompting moves teachers made and their students open-ended feedback on personalized problems were examined through thematic analysis. translated_title: 教师是否应该在循环之中？一项关于生成式AI个性化初中学习任务的研究
translated_abstract: 大语言模型可以被用来设计符合学生需求的教学任务。这些生成式AI模型能够创建与学生校外兴趣（如体育或音乐）相关联的任务，从而可能提升学生的学习兴趣。然而，尽管商业AI公司宣称这些工具能够为教师节省时间，人们对教师使用生成式AI创建或修改任务的具体过程仍知之甚少。在本研究中，7名初中数学教师使用ChatGPT为其课程中的习题创建个性化版本，使之与学生们的兴趣相对应。研究通过主题分析法考察了教师所采用的提示词策略以及学生对个性化习题的开放式反馈，并检验了教师创建习题的效率，以及七年级学生收到个性化作业后的评分情况。本样本的研究结果表明……
tldr: 本研究通过让7名初中数学教师使用ChatGPT创建与学生兴趣相匹配的个性化习题，揭示了教师的提示词策略及其效率，并检验了学生对这些个性化作业的评分反馈。
